name: Desire Pearl Resort
location: Puerto Morelos (45 min from Cancun airport)
description: The highest-rated lifestyle resort in Riviera Maya — an intimate 88-suite couples-only retreat where every detail is engineered for romance. Pearl's boutique scale and relentless service standards make it the premier choice for honeymoons, anniversaries, and milestone celebrations.
highlights: Highest overall satisfaction score in the region (9.3/10)
Couples-only property with 88 luxury villa suites — intimate boutique feel
World-class service: guests describe staff 'like family'
Private oceanview balconies, pristine beach, top-rated dining
Ideal for engagements, weddings, and honeymoons on-site
Clothing-optional designated pool and beach areas
All-inclusive: meals, premium spirits, activities, entertainment
considerations: Smaller property — fewer activity options than larger resorts
May book out months ahead for peak December–February season

reviews.name: Pineapple Travelers
reviews.text: This resort is a shell of its former self. The timeshare sales pressure is even more intense than before — we were told at check-in that our sales appointment was the next day. New management has utterly destroyed this place. A huge portion of the beloved staff has been fired, and cuts in food costs resulted in mostly disgusting food. In five years of visiting twice a year we'd been told maybe twice that guests weren't coming back — that was the theme of this entire trip.

reviews.name: SMB
reviews.text: Upon arrival we were immediately hit with Premier sales pressure. Our room had a strong musty/moldy smell that permeated our luggage. Active construction directly above us began every morning at 7am and continued late into the evening. The constant high-pressure upselling significantly detracted from our experience. Bright spots: bartenders Rosemberg and Sulle at the jacuzzi bar were outstanding, and waiter Orlando was truly the best we've encountered anywhere.

reviews.name: mark b
reviews.text: Just returned from our first time at Pearl — not our first lifestyle resort. Can't say enough about the staff and all the little touches for our anniversary. Beautiful ocean view from the quiet pool. Enjoyed the theme nights and shows. Only complaints: being asked 5-6 times daily about massages, and food is just average for the price point. Yes, we would return — and highly recommend for first-timers.

reviews.name: brad f
reviews.text: First trip to Desire Pearl and it absolutely lived up to the hype. The resort is small — always room at the pool and everything feels relaxed and personal. Every meal at Aphrodite was outstanding: hostess May, waiter Oliver at breakfast, and Eduardo in the evenings were exceptional. Pool staff Gabi kept our cups never empty. We've already booked our return trip for June — we can't wait.

reviews.name: Mande R
reviews.text: My favorite place on Earth to relax and enjoy uninhibited fun! The workers have become like family. Butler Erik is by far our favorite — I wish he were with us back home. Waiter Gilberto at Pearl treats us like family and always makes sure we have what we need. Pool attendant Horacio always gets us our preferred chairs. I do have concerns about money going toward the new stage rather than fixing the jacuzzi bubbles and pool filtration system.

reviews.name: Allen G
reviews.text: We have visited once every year since 2013. The level of service and care from the staff is unmatched — most of them have been here since we first started coming. Butlers Hector, Vincent, and Erick take care of every little detail. Bartenders Eddy, Louis Lugo, and Rosenberg are top-notch. Groundskeeper Javier will get you a fresh coconut in the morning. This resort is truly our second home and family.

reviews.name: ChrisS-035
reviews.text: Our second visit to Pearl and we thoroughly enjoyed every day. Concierge Amir Cabrera was fantastic — he anticipated our needs. Pool attendants Victor and Miguel reserved our preferred chairs. Our couples massage with Tamie and Melissa was over the top. Pool staff Yolanda, Gabi, and Monica were attentive without being overbearing. Bartender Antonio gave us great conversation and perfectly mixed drinks. We are already planning to return in 2027.

reviews.name: Curiosity03745114526
reviews.text: We visited Pearl last March for another wonderful wedding anniversary. The food is exceptional — thank you to chef Ana, Christopher, and Jesus. Our room was very clean and the whole resort was immaculate. Every staff member is welcoming and always ready to help. The pool attendants are wonderful. We will absolutely be back soon.

reviews.name: Chris
reviews.text: My wife and I had been to Desire RM a few times and wanted to try Pearl. We are glad we did. We stayed in the Master Suite, which is a massive space with butler service. Hector and Erick were our butlers and did a solid job organizing some cool birthday events. Our housekeeper Marle did a great job decorating the room for my birthday and anniversary. We got SCUBA certified here thanks to Adolfo, who also helped us book Chichen Itza. The sensual massage with Taimi and Rebecca was an incredible sensory experience. Food at Desire is excellent — especially Te Amo Mexico night with the best local cuisine. Our servers Mayrani and Oliver at Aphrodite brightened every morning with humor. The bartenders and playmakers — especially Candace, Jessica, and Mat — did an excellent job. This resort has an intimate feel and exceptional staff. Anyone thinking about visiting Pearl should give it a try.

reviews.name: Inspire625696
reviews.text: We just got back. We have gone more than 30 trips across 10 years. Since the change in leadership, we have found too many changes to make this desirable. There has been a total change in the playmakers short of Kia, and communication and interaction lacks. The new CEO now severely overcharges for the spa/massage parlor and charges $40 per couple per day for the sauna/steam room area. The only things that make the resort desirable are the staff including: Sophie, Giselle, Eddy, Manuela, Victor, Antonio, Alexis, Saul, Kia, Jairo. If we do decide to come back, it would be due to the staff doing their best to stay motivated under poor leadership. One last thing: there is no longer any usable beach area — it is completely covered with sargassum. We are planning to look for a clothing-optional location with a gorgeous beach focused on the pleasure of the customers.

reviews.name: YogaMilf
reviews.text: We are approaching 20 trips to Desire and have moved from RM to Pearl as home base. We hope Pearl continues to have the boutique feel like RM used to. 2 more trips planned this year. The staff remains undefeated. Just to mention a few names: Eddy at the Melange bar, Oliver and May in Aphrodite, butlers Hector and Irving, all the playmakers, and Desiree at the Spa. A few suggestions: the bottle service areas at Melange seem over the top — it would be great to open those areas up for more seating. The hydrotherapy services in the spa for members should stay free. No complaints this trip, or any trip. Back in August for more fun.

reviews.name: Thomas C
reviews.text: Tom and I spent another great week at the Pearl. Michelle, Carlos and Amir, our mansion butlers, did their usual great job. Hector, Erick and Irving also reached out to see if we needed any assistance. We enjoyed the food and great service at all the restaurants — Mildredt, Manuela, Poot, Wilbert, Oliver, Ray, Joshua, Eduardo and Maryani took great care of us at Aphrodite. At Suki, Ceci and her staff provided excellent service, as did Orlando, Gilberto, Isaac, Raul and Javier at Pearl. The bartenders are all top shelf — Eddy, Jairo, Eduardo, Pedro, Luis, Antonio, Cobb, and Saul among our favourites. Victor, Horatio, Antonio and Miguel do a great job setting us up at the pool. Playmakers Candace and Kia provide great entertainment. The spa staff — Alma, Anais, Desiree, Taimi, and the whole team — provide great services. The staff is what makes the Pearl a special place to vacation!

response.text: Dear guest, thank you for taking the time to share your wonderful experience with us. We are delighted to hear that you and Tom enjoyed another great week at our resort. Your recognition means a great deal and reaffirms our commitment to providing a special vacation experience. We look forward to welcoming you back for another memorable stay.

reviews.name: mandy J
reviews.text: One of our best trips — we have been 20+ times. From check in with Bruno to check out with Frank, both guys are friendly and helpful. Miguel is the nicest guy possible and never fails to get us a bed up the quiet end. May at breakfast always smiling and helpful. Our little Manuela is the cutest, most adorable sweetheart. Oliver always says hello by our name when he sees us walking about. Yolanda we adore — follow her to the coffee shop, lunch or at the pool. The bar staff at Melange are fabulous: Cobb is absolutely the best cocktail maker along with Eddy and Aaron. Our favourite waiters are Gilberto (so lovely and funny) and Eme. Suki was our favourite this time — the food was off the chart. We love the new bar area. Will be back very soon.

reviews.name: funcouple2011
reviews.text: Well, we just got back from Desire Pearl after another great vacation. The staff are what makes this place so great. Gabi our server from the pool bar — her smile can light up any room. Yolanda hustles so fast to get you your order. Kia at the pool is still full of energy, a great playmaker who makes everyone feel very special. Our Butlers Hector and Irving — hard working and very dedicated. Victor, Miguel and Antonio at the pool work crazy hard to get you a nice lounger. Eme worked so hard at the Cinco de Mayo dinner. At Melange: Cob (very experienced), Luis (steadfast), and Claudia (million-watt smile). May at Aphrodite has a great smile to greet you every morning. The food is always great — Suki is the best. Super fast check-in, grounds always well maintained. Please remember to tip the staff. They deserve it!

reviews.name: ReturningCouple_RM
reviews.text: Another fantastic visit to Desire Pearl. The staff remains undefeated — the entertainment team keeps the energy high throughout the day and the themed nights are always creative. The resort is immaculately maintained. Rooms are beautiful. The sky pool area is a special feature that no other resort in the area can match. Cannot recommend highly enough. Already booked our return trip.
